title: 第十六章 内鬼第十七章 破境
content_zh:
夜，深得像一口枯井。
方圆的卧室里没有点灯，只有窗外透进来的月光，在地面上铺了一层薄薄的银白色。老槐树的影子投在窗纸上，随风晃动，像一只无形的手在轻轻拍打。
方圆盘膝坐在床上，双目紧闭，面色惨白如纸。
他的周身没有灵气波动——不是收敛了，而是灵气正在从他的体内流失。
逆向运转《玄帝不灭经》，相当于把一条奔腾的河流强行倒流。河水冲垮河堤，淹没田地，摧毁一切阻挡在面前的东西。
他体内的经脉本就闭塞，全靠血肉骨骼储存灵力。现在灵气逆向运转，那些储存在血肉中的灵力像是被一只无形的手从伤口中往外拽，一丝一丝地离开他的身体。
每流失一分灵力，他的生机就减弱一分。
每减弱一分生机，他就离死亡更近一步。
方圆咬紧牙关，额头上青筋暴起，汗珠顺着脸颊滚落，滴在被褥上，洇出一片深色的水渍。
这不是普通的修炼。
这是一场自杀式的赌博。
《玄帝不灭经》第三层的修炼条件——“生死之间”，不是比喻，不是形容，而是字面上的意思。你必须无限接近死亡，无限接近那一条界线，然后在最后一刻，用本源之力把自己拽回来。
每一次拽回，都是一次“不灭”的重生。
每一次重生，身体都会在濒死的极限状态下突破原有的桎梏，变得更加强韧、更加强大。
方圆前世修炼这一层的时候，用了整整半年时间，在生死边缘走了九次，才将第三层练到大成。
这一世，他要走得更快。
因为他没有半年的时间。
一个月后，青州会武。烈无双要在会武上吞噬各派天才，一举突破金丹境。如果让他在青州城的地盘上成了金丹，整个青州将再无一人能挡他。
方圆必须在那之前，拥有至少能跟烈无双抗衡的实力。
凝气境一重，远远不够。

至少要到凝气境七重以上，加上《玄帝不灭经》的逆天体质，才有可能与筑基境九重巅峰的烈无双一战。
半个月内，从凝气境一重到凝气境七重。
这在任何人看来，都是天方夜谭。
但方圆不是任何人。
卧室外，王紫璇没有回自己的房间。
她搬了把椅子，坐在方圆卧室门口，怀里抱着剑，眼睛盯着那扇紧闭的门。她已经在这里坐了一个时辰，没有动过，没有说话，甚至没有眨眼。
她能感觉到方圆的气息在变弱。
一开始只是细微的波动，像风吹过水面，荡起浅浅的涟漪。但随着时间的推移，那种波动越来越剧烈，像是有人在水中投下了一块巨石，掀起滔天巨浪。
然后，一切都安静了。
太安静了。
安静得像是——什么都没有了。
王紫璇的手猛地抓紧了剑柄，指节泛白。
“方圆？”她轻声喊了一句。
没有人回答。
“方圆！”她的声音提高了，带着一丝颤抖。
还是没有回答。
王紫璇猛地站起来，伸手去推门——
门从里面打开了。
方圆站在门口。
content_en:
The night is as deep as a dry well.
There were no lights in the square bedroom, only the moonlight coming from the window spread a thin layer of silvery white on the ground. The shadow of the old locust tree is cast on the window paper, swaying in the wind, like an invisible hand gently tapping.
Fang Yuan sat cross-legged on the bed, eyes closed, face as pale as paper.
There were no spiritual energy fluctuations around his body - it wasn't that it was converging, but that the spiritual energy was being lost from his body.
Running the "Xuan Emperor's Immortal Sutra" in reverse is equivalent to forcing a rushing river to flow backwards. The river breaks its banks, floods the fields, and destroys everything in its path.
The meridians in his body are already blocked, and he relies entirely on flesh, blood and bones to store spiritual power. Now that the spiritual energy was running in reverse, the spiritual energy stored in his flesh and blood seemed to be pulled out of the wound by an invisible hand, leaving his body bit by bit.
With every bit of spiritual power lost, his vitality weakens.
Every time his vitality weakens, he is one step closer to death.
Fangyuan gritted her teeth, veins popped out on her forehead, and beads of sweat rolled down her cheeks, dripping on the quilt, leaving a dark stain.
This is no ordinary practice.
This is a suicidal gamble.
The cultivation conditions for the third level of "Xuan Emperor Immortality Sutra" - "between life and death" are not metaphors or descriptions, but literal meanings. You must be infinitely close to death, infinitely close to that boundary, and then at the last moment, use the power of your source to pull yourself back.
Every time it is pulled back, it is an "immortal" rebirth.
Every time he is reborn, his body will break through the original shackles in the extreme state of death and become stronger and more powerful.
When Fangyuan practiced this level in his previous life, it took him a full half a year and walked on the edge of life and death nine times before he reached the third level.
In this life, he will go faster.
Because he doesn't have half a year.
A month later, Qingzhou held a martial arts competition. Lie Wushuang wants to devour the geniuses of various factions in martial arts and break through the Golden Core realm in one fell swoop. If he is allowed to become a golden elixir on the territory of Qingzhou City, no one in Qingzhou will be able to stop him.
Fangyuan must have the strength to at least compete with Lie Wushuang before then.
The first level of Qi Condensation Realm is far from enough.
You have to reach at least the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm and above, and with the heaven-defying physique of the "Xuan Emperor Immortality Sutra", it is possible to fight against Lie Wushuang, who is at the peak of the ninth level of the Foundation Establishment Realm.
Within half a month, he went from the first level of Qi Condensation Realm to the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm.
This is a fantasy to anyone.
But Fangyuan is not anyone.
Outside the bedroom, Wang Zixuan did not return to her room.
She moved a chair and sat at the door of Fangyuan's bedroom, holding the sword in her arms and staring at the closed door. She had been sitting here for an hour, not moving, not speaking, not even blinking.
She could feel Fangyuan's aura weakening.
At first it was just a slight fluctuation, like the wind blowing across the water, causing shallow ripples. But as time went by, the fluctuations became more and more violent, as if someone dropped a huge rock in the water, causing huge waves.
Then everything went quiet.
It's so quiet.
It was so quiet that there was nothing.
Wang Zixuan's hand suddenly grasped the hilt of the sword, and her knuckles turned white.
"Fang Yuan?" She called softly.
No one answered.
"Fang Yuan!" Her voice rose, with a hint of trembling.
Still no answer.
Wang Zixuan stood up suddenly and reached out to push the door——
The door opened from the inside.
Fangyuan stood at the door.
